authorization: Explicit usage permission is checked separately for fitting, evaluation and redistribution. Unknown means not eligible for the corresponding use.

tasks.CLASSIFIER_ELIGIBLE: A verified single glyph with correct class, usable crop and no content conflict; parent completeness and full text are not required. Group and split must be verified. Domains are reported separately.
tasks.CHARACTER_DETECTION_ELIGIBLE: Verified complete character coverage across the image, no extra or duplicate box, and no chart. Use one class character first. Missing class coverage, box errors and all rows still require a semantic review of the dataset, not classifier confidence.
tasks.FULL_PLATE_EVALUATION_ELIGIBLE: Exact verified full plate text, known image/crop scope, verified group, independent frozen cohort and evaluation rights. Never derive truth merely from the OCR output or from sorting potentially incomplete boxes.

benchmarks.glyph_classification: Verified individual glyph box/class, even if no full text; accuracy, macro F1 and per-class recall with support and confusion matrix; report domains separately.
benchmarks.character_detection: Verified complete character boxes and valid reading order per plate; IoU >= 0.5 one-to-one F1, mAP50-95 and glyph count errors; report by rows and size.
benchmarks.plate_detection: Verified vehicle-scene plate boxes, including valid negatives with verified absence; mAP50-95 and recall by plate size/layout/blur.
benchmarks.end_to_end: Verified full text and scene/crop provenance, ordered reading, exact match and CER with missing detections counted as empty predictions; separate supplied-crop evaluation from scene inference.

isolation: Keep verified groups and unresolved duplicate components in a single split. Check full-image and plate-crop overlap. Never tune on Pilot/New10/Final Test. A hash component does not prove common identity or independence.
training_order: YOLO Plate after License_Data/VNLP pass their own gates
